    Profile

    An incarnation of Setsuna who has fallen to the Darkness, divested of the hopes she held during her lifetime. She carries within her the sin of envy. It has subverted her compassion, which she had slowly regained over the course of her wandering travels, and fills her with nothing but hatred for the living, the subjects of her jealousy. She is constantly seething with the urge to destroy all life.

    Origin: Wadatsumi
    Gender: Female
    Height: 162cm
    Weight: 48kg
